title: Sales, stock and credit: san abin da kuka sayar da kuma wanda ke bin ku bashi

say: Sales, stock and credit: san abin da kuka sayar, da kuma wanda ke bin ku bashi.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don Module 2, tallace-tallace, haja da bayanan kiredit.
Littafin tallace-tallacen ku shine shafin da aka fi amfani dashi a cikin kasuwancin ku. Idan ka adana rikodin guda ɗaya kawai, kiyaye wannan.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi

say: Katin hannun jari yana nuna inda yawancin kuɗin kasuwancin ku ke zaune: akan ɗakunan ajiya.

say: Kowane tallace-tallace yana samun layi ɗaya: kwanan wata, abu, adadi, farashi, jimlar, da yadda aka biya shi. Cash, canja wuri, ko bashi.
Misali, Funke tana sayar da kayan abinci a Ibadan.

card.title: Littafin tallace-tallace na Funke, wata safiya

say: Ta sayar da bokitin fenti guda 4 na garri akan kudi kimanin naira 3,500, wato naira 14,000. Haka kuma ta kai kananan kofuna 12 na crayfish akan naira 500, wani naira 6,000. Kuɗin da ta sayar ya kai naira 20,000.

say: Bokiti biyu na wake akan kudi kusan naira 5,000 ana biyansu ta hanyar canja wuri. Naira 10,000 kenan.

card.title: Littafin tallace-tallace na Funke, wata safiya

say: Mataki na uku. Bude bankin ku ko aikace-aikacen walat ɗin ku kuma yi alama ga kowane canja wuri mai shigowa akan layi a cikin littafinku. Fadakarwar da ba ta dace ba galibi tana nufin siyar da aka manta.
Koyaushe tabbatar da kuɗin yana cikin asusun ku kafin kaya ya tafi. Kar a taɓa amincewa kawai allon wayar abokin ciniki.

say: Ƙidaya lokaci ɗaya kowane mako, misali Asabar bayan rufewa. Rubuta ɓarna, ɓarna da kayan da aka ɗauka don gida a cikin ginshiƙi na waje. Fara sayar da tsofaffin hannun jari.
Kuma kar a sayar da abinci, abin sha ko magunguna da suka wuce ranar ƙarewar su. Cire su, yi rikodin su kamar yadda suka lalace, sa'annan ku sayi ƙaramin adadi a gaba.

panel.heading: Lokacin da ka ƙidaya hannun jari
items: Rana ɗaya da lokaci kowane mako
Yi rikodin karyewa da amfani da gida azaman waje
Fara sayar da tsofaffin hannun jari
Kar a taɓa sayar da abinci, abin sha ko magani da ya ƙare

say: Rubuta kowane bashi a gaban abokin ciniki kuma karanta shi tare da kwanan watan da ya ƙare. Yi rikodin kowane ɓangaren biyan kuɗi da sabon ma'auni.
Misali, Chioma tana sayar da masana'anta a Aba. A karshen wata, Ada, Joy da Uche suna bin ta naira 73,000. Bashin Uche yana da sati 7 kenan.
Hannun jarin mako mai zuwa zai kai kimanin naira 120,000, kuma tana da 60,000 kacal a hannunta. Don haka ta kira Ada yau, ta amince da kwananta da Joy, sannan ta dakatar da bashi Uche.
Tsara basussuka da shekaru kuma a fara fara korar mafi tsufa. Idan bashi ya dade yana jira, da wahalar tarawa.

Saita dokokin ku. Kiredit kawai ga abokan ciniki na yau da kullun da kuka sani, iyaka ga kowane mutum, bayyanannen ranar biyan kuɗi, babu sabon kiredit har sai an biya bashi na ƙarshe, kuma babu siyar da bashi ba tare da layi a cikin jerin ba.

panel.heading: Saita dokokin kiredit ɗin ku
items: Wanene: abokan ciniki na yau da kullun tare da wayar aiki
Nawa: iyaka ga kowane mutum
Har yaushe: bayyanannen kwanan watan biya
Daya bayan daya: babu sabon bashi har sai an biya
Rubuta shi kowane lokaci

say: Yanzu gudanar da cikakken ranar littafin tallace-tallace, gina taƙaitawar mako-mako, fara katin haja don babban samfurin ku, kuma tsaftace jerin masu bashi. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
